name: Natural Networks LNRS Delivery Fund
summary: Capital grants for projects that create, restore and connect priority habitats and support species recovery in Worcestershire, delivering measures from the county's Local Nature Recovery Strategy, with free advice before applying.

amount.note: Funds up to 75% of eligible project costs

applicant_types.quote: estates small and medium-sized enterprises charities constituted voluntary and community organisations parish and town councils public bodies

geography.quote: be located within or deliver significant ecological benefits to habitats or species within Worcestershire

access.quote: If you are ready to apply you can register on the Council grants portal by emailing: grants@worcestershire.gov.uk

amount.quote: Grants of between £5,000 to £50,000 are available. The programme will fund up to 75% of eligible project costs.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants must contribute a minimum of 25% of total project costs through their own resources or other eligible sources of match funding.
